preconditions.description: The dimensions of the grid are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == m for s in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row in the grid has the same length as the number of columns.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'WB' for row in grid for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either 'W' (white) or 'B' (black).

postconditions.description: The number of coins spent is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(grid[i][j] == target_grid[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: The grid matches the target grid after applying the operations.
